issues.desc: CHK-002 context includes the phrase "Optionally surface primary in usage-ledger-report.ts renderHuman" — the word Optionally is advisory texture inside an otherwise verifiable checklist item. It is not a separate checklist item and does not create a verification gap, but if the implementer skips it the checklist item still passes without any note of the omission. Consider either splitting it into a separate optional CHK or rewriting as "If renderHuman is updated, confirm primary is labelled distinctly from the four-field totals.". Non-blocking.
